newsitem.title: ERITREA: Sudanese opposition names war council.
newsitem.headline: Sudanese opposition names war council.

text.p: Sudanese opposition groups have named a committee to plan and coordinate military operations against the Islamist military government in Khartoum, a senior opposition figure said.
The decion to put together the four-person committee comes after the formation last week of a military force grouping rebel forces fighting Sudan.

The new coordinating committee includes Sudanese rebel leader John Garang, who heads the largest rebel group, the South Sudan People's Liberation Army (SPLA), Mansour Khalid, foreign secretary of the opposition coalition National Democratic Alliance (NDA) told Reuters on Friday.

The joint military force is made up of the SPLA, the Sudan Alliance Forces and the Beja Congress. Besides Garang the other members of the military coordinating committee are from the NDA senior leadership.
Khalid said Khartoum, alarmed by the new unity among Sudanese opposition groups, has been pressing Garang for dialogue to end the war in the south.
Garang's SPLA has been fighting since 1983 for greater autonomy or independence for the mainly Christian and animist south of Sudan from the Moslem, Arabised north.
The rebel war has killed hundreds of thousands of people and displaced and sent into exile many more.
Eritrea, which says Sudan's Islamic government of General Omar Hassan al-Bashir is trying to destabilise the region, supports the NDA in its campaign against the government.
